title: か — the question particle
summary: A particle at the end of a sentence that makes it a question. It is added after polite sentences (〜です, 〜ます), and also to sentences with a question word.

body.p: Adding か to the end makes the sentence a question. A question mark is not required.
Answer with はい or いいえ. For a question-word question, give the actual information.
With friends, drop か and raise the tone (行く？). Adding か in casual speech can sound blunt.

examples.ja: あなたは学生（がくせい）ですか。
これはあなたの本（ほん）ですか。
examples.romaji: Kore wa anata no hon desu ka.

examples.ja: 今日（きょう）は暑（あつ）いですか。

pitfalls: か goes at the end, even in a sentence with a question word.
A question mark after か is optional.
